images.alt: Josephine Elworthy, 2022 Outdoor Access Champion, shows a bush trail in Clevedon to a group of five other people. Josephine (wearing a green cowboy hat) and her Clevedon Trails Steering Group colleagues have worked toward a trail network in Clevedon for over a decade.

post.text:
We are seeking Outdoor Access Champion Award nominations for people and groups who champion public access to the outdoors. 🏆
They recognise those who have made significant and lasting contributions to public access to the outdoors in Aotearoa. 
More details: www.herengaanuku.govt.nz/our-work/new...
